answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation aims to produce human-understandable text from semi-structured data such as tables, concepts, etc.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text describing structured input data

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of generated text, we use three popular metrics-BLEU, ROUGE and METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005) 1 . We also use a recent data-to-text generation evaluation metric, PARENT

answer_4.quote: we select four university graduate students from various majors... Every instance is annotated by at least three human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Every annotator is asked to rate each text on a scale of 1 to 5, where 5 is the best. In human-based evaluation, we primarily look for two essential qualities in generated texts-adequacy (or correctness) and readability (or fluency).
